school: 唐代高僧/法相唯识宗创始人/佛经翻译家/西行求法者/那烂陀寺留学僧/《大唐西域记》口述者/汉传佛教新译运动主持者
historical_significance: 玄奘（602-664），俗名陈祎，洛州缑氏人，13岁出家，因觉当时汉传佛典译本歧异、义理纷诤（地论师与摄论师判释相违），遂发愿西行求取原典。贞观三年（629，一说627）混入饥民私度玉门关出关，孤身穿越莫贺延碛八百里流沙，'宁可就西而死，岂归东而生'；经高昌麴文泰结盟资助，历西域诸国，入印度那烂陀寺从戒贤法师习《瑜伽师地论》等，五年穷尽寺藏，又周游五印度参学十余年。641年曲女城无遮大会上，以十八日立'真唯识量'悬论无人能破，被大乘众尊为'大乘天'、小乘众尊为'解脱天'。贞观十九年（645）携657部梵本归长安，太宗敕建译场，此后十九年主持译出经论75部1335卷（约1300万字），系统重译《大般若经》《瑜伽师地论》《俱舍论》等，创'五不翻'音译原则与译主-证义-笔受-缀文-润文多岗流水译场制，史称'新译'，与罗什旧译分野。口述行程由辩机笔录成《大唐西域记》十二卷，记录138国风土政教，成为复原中亚南亚古代史地的第一手文献。糅译《成唯识论》确立法相唯识宗（慈恩宗），经窥基、圆测传扬，并东传日本。664年译罢《咒药经》数行而寂于玉华宫，'府库中经论已盈'而尽。
historical_significance_en: Xuanzang (602-664), born Chen Yi in Goushi, Luozhou, ordained at thirteen. Finding Chinese Buddhist texts mutually inconsistent and doctrinal disputes unresolvable (the Dilun and Shelun schools dividing over the same treatise), he vowed to fetch the originals from India. In 629 he slipped through the Yumen Pass among famine refugees, crossed the 800-li Moheyan Desert alone—'better to die going west than to live returning east'—gained the alliance and funding of Qu Wentai of Gaochang, and reached Nalanda, where he studied the Yogacarabhumi-sastra under Silabhadra for five years and exhausted the monastery's library, then toured India for over a decade more. At the 641 Kanauj assembly he posted his 'True Consciousness-Only syllogism' for eighteen days unrefuted, honored as 'Mahayana-deva' by Mahayanists and 'Moksa-deva' by Hinayanists. Returning to Chang'an in 645 with 657 Sanskrit texts, under imperial patronage he directed a translation bureau for nineteen years, producing 75 works in 1,335 rolls (some 13 million characters), including the Great Perfection of Wisdom, the Yogacarabhumi and the Abhidharmakosa; his 'five non-translation' principle and multi-role assembly-line bureau founded the 'new translation' era after Kumarajiva's 'old'. His dictated Great Tang Records on the Western Regions, taken down by Bianji, documents 138 polities and remains a primary source for Central and South Asian history. His integrated Cheng Weishi Lun founded the Faxiang (Consciousness-Only) school, carried on by Kuiji and Woncheuk and transmitted to Japan. He died at Yuhua Palace in 664, having stopped mid-translation of one last text.
description_zh: 玄奘的思维底色是'在源头与裁决之间做最贵的投资'：当解释框架互相冲突时，他不加入任何一派论战，而是判断'我们的分歧是因为文本残缺'，于是用十七年往返五万里把裁决依据本身搬回来。归国后他连续做了三次标准化工程：一是术语标准化（五不翻——在'可译'与'当译'之间划出制度边界，宁可音译也不让概念被旧词污染）；二是流程标准化（把翻译从个人天才行为改造成译主、证义、笔受、缀文、参译、刊定、润文十余道工序的流水线，个人可靠性变成系统可靠性）；三是文本标准化（对旧译歧本不作修补而作重译，用一手梵本整体替换）。他的辩论方法（真唯识量）是把体系最怕被攻击的一点主动写成公开悬论、限日受检——用可证伪性代替权威压服。他的记录方法（大唐西域记）是行进中的结构化田野调查：路线、里程、国祚、语言、佛法盛衰逐国登记。总纲一以贯之：把信念问题还原为文本问题，把文本问题还原为工程问题。
description_en: Xuanzang's signature was 'making the most expensive possible investment between the source and the verdict': when interpretive schools clashed, he joined no faction but judged 'our disputes come from defective texts', and spent seventeen years and fifty thousand li bringing the basis of judgment home. After returning he ran three standardization projects in succession: terminological standardization (the five non-translation rules—an institutional boundary between 'translatable' and 'must stay foreign', preferring transliteration to letting old words contaminate concepts); procedural standardization (turning translation from an act of individual genius into an assembly line of over a dozen roles—translator-in-chief, doctrine verifiers, scribes, text-weavers, bilingual checkers, redactors, polishers—converting personal reliability into systemic reliability); and textual standardization (retranslation wholesale from first-hand Sanskrit rather than patching disputed old versions). His debating method (the True Consciousness-Only syllogism) took the doctrine's most attackable point and posted it as an open challenge with a deadline—falsifiability instead of authority. His recording method (the Records) was structured fieldwork in motion: route, distance, dynasty, language and state of the Dharma registered country by country. One principle throughout: reduce questions of belief to questions of text, and questions of text to questions of engineering.

那烂陀寺留学僧与曲女城无遮大会论主（'大乘天'）
国家译场主持人（645-664，译经75部1335卷，'新译'开创者）
翻译理论家（五不翻原则、译场多岗分工制度设计者）
法相唯识宗创始人（糅译《成唯识论》，传窥基、圆测）
地理与民俗记录者（口述《大唐西域记》十二卷138国）
roles_en: Pilgrim-scholar (629-645, fifty thousand li round trip, 657 Sanskrit texts brought back)
Nalanda student and victor of the Kanauj assembly ('Mahayana-deva')
Director of the state translation bureau (645-664, 75 works / 1,335 rolls, founder of the 'new translation')
Translation theorist (five non-translation principles; designer of the multi-role bureau)
Founder of the Faxiang (Consciousness-Only) school (integrated Cheng Weishi Lun; heirs Kuiji and Woncheuk)
Geographic and ethnographic recorder (dictated the Great Tang Records on the Western Regions, 12 rolls, 138 polities)

译《俱舍论》三十卷（说一切有部之要籍）
口述《大唐西域记》十二卷（辩机笔受，646年成书）
《会宗论》三千颂（调和那烂陀中观、瑜伽之争）
真唯识量（曲女城无遮大会十八日无人能破之悬论）
译《因明入正理论》《因明正理门论》（引入印度因明学）
